program.name: Pull Ladders
program.subject: Climber / pull strength
program.blurb: Pull-up ladders: one rep, then two, then three, with a lock-off or hang between climbs.
program.about: Pull-up volume built the patient way, with ladders. One rep, then two, then three, climbing as long as the clock allows, with a hang, a lock-off or a core move at each rung. Two days alternate grips. A short circuit for the upper back follows. Abs finish every session. Levels II and III add reps, so the ladder climbs further.
